parameters.query:
SELECT 
  *
FROM public.vendors
WHERE 
  vendor_name ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
  OR contact_email ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
  OR website ILIKE '%{{ $json.params.search }}%'
ORDER BY vendor_name ASC 
LIMIT {{ $json.params.limit }} 
OFFSET {{ $json.params.offset }}
DELETE FROM vendors WHERE vendor_id = {{ $json.params.id }} RETURNING *;

WITH vendor_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT v.vendor_id) as total_vendors,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.vendor_icon_name IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as vendors_with_icon,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.website IS NOT NULL AND v.website != '' THEN 1 END) as vendors_with_website,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN v.contact_email IS NOT NULL AND v.contact_email != '' THEN 1 END) as vendors_with_email
  FROM vendors v
),
order_stats AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) as total_orders,
    SUM(total_cost) as total_spent,
    MAX(order_date) as last_order_date
  FROM orders
),
top_vendor AS (
  SELECT
    v.vendor_id,
    v.vendor_name,
    COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count,
    SUM(o.total_cost) as total_spent,
    CASE 
      WHEN v.vendor_icon_name IS NOT NULL 
      THEN CONCAT('http://192.168.0.7:5678/webhook/image?filename=', v.vendor_icon_name)
      ELSE NULL
    END as vendor_icon
  FROM vendors v
  LEFT JOIN orders o ON v.vendor_id = o.vendor_id
  GROUP BY v.vendor_id, v.vendor_name, v.vendor_icon_name
  ORDER BY order_count DESC, total_spent DESC
  LIMIT 1
),
recent_purchase AS (
  SELECT
    v.vendor_name,
    o.order_date,
    o.total_cost,
    CASE 
      WHEN v.vendor_icon_name IS NOT NULL 
      THEN CONCAT('http://192.168.0.7:5678/webhook/image?filename=', v.vendor_icon_name)
      ELSE NULL
    END as vendor_icon
  FROM orders o
  JOIN vendors v ON o.vendor_id = v.vendor_id
  ORDER BY o.order_date DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT 
  (SELECT row_to_json(vendor_stats.*) FROM vendor_stats) as vendor_stats,
  (SELECT row_to_json(order_stats.*) FROM order_stats) as order_stats,
  (SELECT row_to_json(top_vendor.*) FROM top_vendor) as top_vendor,
  (SELECT row_to_json(recent_purchase.*) FROM recent_purchase) as recent_purchase;

INSERT INTO public.vendors (
  vendor_name,
  website,
  contact_email,
  phone_number,
  vendor_icon_name,
  vendor_icon_type,
  vendor_icon_content
)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.body.vendor_name }}',
  '{{ $json.body.website }}',
  '{{ $json.body.contact_email }}',
  '{{ $json.body.phone_number }}',
  '{{ $json.body.vendor_icon_name }}',
  '{{ $json.body.vendor_icon_type }}',
  decode('{{ $json.body.vendor_icon_content }}', 'base64')
)
RETURNING 
  vendor_id,
  vendor_name,
  website,
  contact_email,
  phone_number,
  vendor_icon_name,
  vendor_icon_type,
  vendor_icon_content,
  CASE 
    WHEN vendor_icon_name IS NOT NULL 
    THEN CONCAT('http://192.168.0.7:5678/webhook/image?filename=', vendor_icon_name)
    ELSE NULL
  END as filename;
